purpose: Per-hypothesis, per-region geographic applicability of H1-H7's CURRENT resolved evidence, built to prevent single-region findings from being silently read as national/multi-national/cross-country generalizations.
anti_overgeneralization_rules: PJM evidence is never promoted to MATCHED for USA as a whole.
US evidence is never promoted to MATCHED/PARTIAL_MATCH for Korea, and vice versa.
Ireland's data-center-electricity-share figure is never used as an EU-wide average.
A derivative/secondary China estimate is never promoted to an official Chinese observed value.
Korea capital-region CONTRACTED power capacity is never converted into actual AI electricity consumption.
ireland_eu_note: Ireland's ~22% data-center-electricity-share figure (CSO/EirGrid) is a COUNTRY-LEVEL figure. It must never be used as an EU-wide average -- Ireland is a small, data-center-dense outlier economy, not representative of the EU aggregate (EU-wide data center electricity share is far lower, on the order of a few percent per IEA).
